feature: MQTT durable Session detached shared-Publication ownership

reference.pattern: refcounted base-message ownership retained through Session delivery

objective: Eliminate the durable Session detach copy of Topic Name, payload, and variable-length MQTT 5 property values without borrowing Session storage after releasing the broker state lock.

design.eligibility: Only OwnedPublish values whose wire_allocation_len equals shared_publication_properties expose a SharedPublication owner.
design.detach: Copy property descriptors into connection scratch, retain the SharedPublication, and continue borrowing its Topic Name, payload, and property-value bytes until the socket write finishes.
design.fallback: Session-owned wire allocations and shared-publication wire copies retain the existing deep-copy path.
design.lifetime: DetachedSessionPacket releases the retained Publication on success, oversized drop, socket failure, retry, continue, and return paths.
preserved_invariants: durable state commits before network-visible progress
Client ID takeover cannot invalidate detached bytes
PUBREL routing and PUBCOMP ordering are unchanged
ordinary and alias-rewritten Session transmissions still deep-copy

verification.focused_command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='detached Session transmission' -Dtest-filter='MQTT durable QoS 2' --summary all
verification.integration_observation: The first complete broker build exposed that the retained owner must be released by the broker-level DetachedSessionPacket rather than only session_route.DetachedPacket; the candidate was corrected and then built as the recorded ReleaseFast binary.

rejection_reason: The optional SharedPublication pointer and retained-owner path increased broker instructions by about 0.43% and cycles by about 0.67% at paired medians, with only 2/8 and 3/8 wins. Throughput and both latency percentiles were also neutral-to-negative. Removing one bounded memcpy did not repay the common-path representation and ownership cost.
follow_up: Do not grow every PublishTransmission or add a retained-owner branch to its common path. A later attempt must carry ownership in a broker-only selection sidecar or move the optimization below the existing transmission representation, then pass the same fixed-binary PMU guard before broader matrices.
